```{r}
# install.packages("tidyverse")
library(tidyverse)
library(dplyr)
# install.packages("aod")
library(aod)

msleep<-glimpse(msleep)
storms<-storms
lizards<- lizards

head(msleep)
head(storms)
head(lizards)
```

# Mammals sleep dataset (msleep)
## 1.)
```{r}

subset<-msleep|>
  filter(awake>=12)

subset

```

## 2.)
```{r}
percent_dayawake<-msleep |>
  mutate((awake/24)*100)

percent_dayawake|>
  select(awake, everything())

percent_dayawake

```

# Storms tracks data (storms)
## 3.)
```{r}
storms|> str()

storms |>
  group_by(year) |>
  summarise(num_storms=n())

```

## 4.)
```{r}
storms |>
  filter(wind>50) |>
  arrange(desc(wind))

```

# A Comparison of Site Preferences of Two Species of Lizard (lizards)
## 5.)
```{r}
lizards|>
  group_by(Site, Diameter) |>
  summarize (
    new_grahami=sum(grahami)) |>
  arrange(desc(new_grahami))

```

## 6.)
```{r}
ggplot(data=lizards,
       aes(x=opalinus, y=Site)) +
  geom_boxplot(aes(fill = "opalinus")) +
  labs(title = "Distribution of opalinus counts under different light conditions") 

```
